title: Data science, analytics and BI rigour
description: Turns the GSD phase loop into an expert analytics workflow: an ANALYSIS-SPEC contract written before the data is touched, specialist agents that fill it, and deterministic Python gates that block the loop when the statistics, the causal claims, the ML splits, the metric definitions, the data-quality profile, the chart seals, the narrative wording, the entrypoint fit order, decision replay, repro_lock or unauthorised findings do not hold up. v1.5 adds ADR/SPEC finding suppressions and scored CHART-REVIEW.md via dsx-chart-audit. v2.0 restores the IT001-IT040 data-input-type inventory as a deterministic chart lookup (`dsx charts`), so chart choice is consulted rather than asked, and DSX-VIZ-013 blocks a mark the declared data shape does not admit.

notes.*: Gates shell out to the bundled `dsx` Python CLI. Requires python3 on PATH (stdlib only — no third-party packages needed).

dsx.enforce.description: Master switch. When false, every dsx gate is skipped and the capability contributes prompt guidance only.

dsx.require_spec.description: Fail the plan gate when a phase has no ANALYSIS-SPEC. Leave false in mixed repositories where only some phases are analytical; set true in a pure analytics project.

dsx.viz_audit.description: Audit declared chart specs for encoding correctness, proportionality and uncertainty display before shipping.

dsx.causal_guard.description: Block causal wording that the declared identification strategy does not support.

dsx.reproducibility_gate.description: Require a seed, a pinned environment, identifiable data and a working entrypoint before a phase ships.

dsx.dq_gate.description: Compare data[].assertions against DATA-PROFILE.yaml artifacts at execute/verify/ship. Prefer profiles produced by `dsx profile`.

dsx.figure_seal.description: Require svg_sha256 seals for visuals with artifact_path at verify/ship, and enforce FIGURE-MANIFEST coverage when present.

dsx.narrative_gate.description: Require narrative.path when claims exist, claim⊆deliverable, and forbidden-wording scans at verify/ship.

dsx.code_gate.description: Scan reproducibility.entrypoint for fit-before-split and related leakage smells at execute/verify/ship.

dsx.decision_replay.description: Evaluate structured decision.replay thresholds against results.tests at verify/ship.

dsx.repro_lock.description: Require reproducibility.repro_lock (or explicit null opt-out) when results.tests is non-empty.

dsx.domain.description: Biases which specialist agents and reference tables the planner loads. 'auto' infers from the phase goal.

dsx.python.description: Interpreter used to run the dsx CLI. Override when python3 is not on PATH.
